name: Rizwan Image Alt Text WEBP Optimizer
author: rizwanplugins

sections.description:
Rizwan Image Alt Text WEBP Optimizer helps optimize WordPress images with automatic alt text generation, WebP conversion, SEO scoring, and lazy loading support.

Features

  • Automatic image alt text generation
  • Automatic WebP conversion
  • SEO score analysis
  • Lazy loading support
  • Dashboard analytics
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rizwan-image-alt-text-webp-optimizer directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Rizwan Image Alt Text and WebP Optimizer dashboard from the WordPress admin menu.
